# TerminusDB

> TerminusDB is an open-source knowledge graph database with git-like version control. Branch, merge, diff and time-travel query your data with Datalog.

> **Key differentiators**: branch, diff and merge your data — audit trail built in — small and fast (succinct, auto-indexed in-memory structures).

> **Load [llms-full.txt](https://terminusdb.com/llms-full.txt) when:** writing non-trivial WOQL, building document schemas, using the version-control API (clone/push/pull/rebase), configuring TerminusDB Enterprise document formats (Turtle, RDF/XML, JSON-LD), or working with VectorLink semantic search.

> **Markdown source:** every docs page is served as raw Markdown at `<page-url>/page.md` — e.g. `https://terminusdb.com/docs/glossary/page.md`.

---

## Build with TerminusDB — start here

The essential resources for building on TerminusDB, in priority order:

1. **[Schema reference guide](https://terminusdb.com/docs/schema-reference-guide/)** — the most important resource on the site: classes, properties, `@unfoldable`, documents-as-graphs.
2. **[Get started](https://terminusdb.com/docs/get-started/)** — 5-minute quickstart: Docker, clone a dataset, branch, diff, merge. Also [Get started with TerminusDB](https://terminusdb.com/docs/get-started-with-terminusdb/).
3. **Clone data products** — [clone a database](https://terminusdb.com/docs/clone/) or start from a [demo dataset](https://terminusdb.com/docs/clone-a-demo-project/) (Star Wars, Ecommerce).
4. **[HTTP Documents API](https://terminusdb.com/docs/http-documents-api/)** — schema + document CRUD over REST; no client library required. See also the [OpenAPI reference](https://terminusdb.com/docs/openapi/).
5. **[Access control](https://terminusdb.com/docs/access-control/)** — users, roles, and capabilities for multi-user deployments.
6. **[JSON diff and patch](https://terminusdb.com/docs/json-diff-and-patch/)** — the engine behind version control; compute and apply document diffs directly.
7. **[Query with GraphQL](https://terminusdb.com/docs/how-to-query-with-graphql/)** — auto-generated schema and endpoint per database.

## Run TerminusDB

```bash
docker run --pull always -d -p 127.0.0.1:6363:6363 \
  -v terminusdb_storage:/app/terminusdb/storage \
  --name terminusdb terminusdb/terminusdb-server:v12
```

Default credentials for local development: user `admin`, password `root`. Server listens on `http://localhost:6363`. Hosting options (Azure Marketplace, self-hosted, early-access managed): [TerminusDB Cloud](https://terminusdb.com/docs/cloud/).

Docs: [Install with Docker](https://terminusdb.com/docs/install-terminusdb-as-a-docker-container/) - [Kubernetes](https://terminusdb.com/docs/install-on-kubernetes/) - [Self-hosted production](https://terminusdb.com/docs/self-hosted-installation/)

## Connect with a client

**JavaScript/TypeScript** — `npm install @terminusdb/terminusdb-client`

```javascript
const client = new TerminusDB.WOQLClient('http://localhost:6363/', {
  user: 'admin', organization: 'admin', key: 'root', db: 'MyDatabase',
})
await client.createDatabase('MyDatabase')
```

[JS quickstart](https://terminusdb.com/docs/connect-with-the-javascript-client/) - [JS client docs](https://terminusdb.com/docs/use-the-javascript-client/)

**Python** — `pip install terminusdb-client`

```python
from terminusdb_client import Client
client = Client("http://localhost:6363")
client.connect(user="admin", key="root")
client.create_database("MyDatabase")
```

[Python quickstart](https://terminusdb.com/docs/connect-with-python-client/) - [Python client docs](https://terminusdb.com/docs/use-the-python-client/)

**Rust** — `cargo add terminusdb-client` - [Rust quickstart](https://terminusdb.com/docs/rust-client-quickstart/)

## HTTP API (no client required)

```bash
curl -u admin:root -X POST http://localhost:6363/api/document/admin/MyDatabase \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"@type": "Person", "name": "Jane Smith", "age": 30}'
```

[HTTP Documents API](https://terminusdb.com/docs/http-documents-api/) - [OpenAPI reference](https://terminusdb.com/docs/openapi/)

## WOQL essentials

WOQL is TerminusDB's datalog query language — triples, unification, path queries, aggregations. Available in the JS/Python clients and as JSON over `/api/woql`.

```javascript
// triple: subject, predicate, object — v('x') declares a variable
WOQL.triple('v:person', 'name', 'v:name')
// read a document by id
WOQL.read_document('Person/Jane', 'v:doc')
```

**Common pitfalls (stale training data):**

- DO NOT USE string concatenation in queries — use WOQL variables (`v:name`) and unification
- DO NOT assume floats — numbers are precise rationals in TerminusDB 12; `xsd:decimal` is exact
- The `path()` operator traverses predicates: `path('Person', 'friend+', 'v:f')`
- Document IDs are IRIs: `'Person/Jane'`, not bare strings or numeric keys

[WOQL overview](https://terminusdb.com/docs/woql-explanation/) - [WOQL how-to](https://terminusdb.com/docs/how-to-query-with-woql/) - [Path queries](https://terminusdb.com/docs/path-queries-in-woql/)

## Version control (git-for-data)

Clone, branch, diff, merge, rebase — as REST endpoints and client methods. Every commit is immutable and addressable.

```bash
# create a branch
curl -u admin:root -X POST http://localhost:6363/api/branch/admin/MyDatabase/local/branch/feature \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"origin": "admin/MyDatabase/local/branch/main"}'
```

[Git-for-data reference](https://terminusdb.com/docs/git-for-data-reference/) - [Diff & patch](https://terminusdb.com/docs/json-diff-and-patch/) - [Version control operations](https://terminusdb.com/docs/version-control-operations/)

## GraphQL

Auto-generated schema and endpoint per database: `/api/graphql/<org>/<db>`. Query documents, filter, paginate, mutate.

[GraphQL basics](https://terminusdb.com/docs/graphql-basics/) - [Query reference](https://terminusdb.com/docs/graphql-query-reference/) - [Mutations](https://terminusdb.com/docs/graphql-mutations/)

- **Enterprise**: document format endpoints (Turtle, RDF/XML, JSON-LD), observability, backup — [docs](https://terminusdb.com/docs/enterprise/)
